text:
LiftIron is in Grok Bot.
Not a logbook. A strength coach in chat.
Tell it the last set. It calls the next weight and reps, estimates your one-rep max, and flags the deload before the plateau owns you.
Same progression rules as the app. No account. No quiz.
https://x.ai/bot/15IifJPKsctHV1s9sIcTH
Short features
Next-set weight and reps from your logged history
Estimated one-rep max from the work you already did
Deload call when progress stalls
LiftIron progression rules, in chat
No account, no quiz, no third-party tracker
